text:
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for chart: service-notifications v1.9.0 -> v1.10.0. Reason: values checksum changed and image tag 'prod-latest' resolves to multiple digests in registry. Auto-promotion locked and lockfile created.

hema: ugh, registry retag again. which digest did staging validate?

jorge: staging ran against sha256:1111...aaaa (2026-06-20T12:10Z). Registry shows another push sha256:2222...bbbb at 2026-06-20T12:45Z.

ops: picking the wrong digest could regress a hotfix. plan: pin to staging digest, add extended smoke, and annotate the release so deploy-bot knows this is intentional.

hema: I'll open a tiny overlay PR to set `image.digest: sha256:1111...aaaa` and keep tag for readability.

hema: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/notifications/PR-401 — overlay `overlays/notifications/pin-image.yaml` + changelog entry about duplicate tag.

release-lead: executing `/deploy override pin-notif-401` now to allow promotion with pinned digest.

deploy-bot: Override accepted from @release-lead. Creating locked candidate `pin-notif-401`. Starting canary (2% traffic) in us-west. Extended smoke enabled (10m).

(smoke output)
2026-06-20T13:02:05Z  health OK
2026-06-20T13:05:12Z  notifications queue processed successfully
2026-06-20T13:06:10Z  latency P95=80ms

ops: smoke looks good, no errors or abnormal traces. proceeding to 100%.

deploy-bot: Promotion completed to 100% in us-west. Lockfile `pin-notif-401` closed. Release notes updated: "Pinned image digest for service-notifications to sha256:1111...aaaa due to registry retag of tag 'prod-latest'." Follow-up ticket created: INFRA-702 to add registry push alerts and retag prevention window.

release-lead: thanks team, closing thread.
